description: Add conditional formatting to a spreadsheet in WPS Spreadsheet. Open /home/ga/Documents/inventory.xlsx which contains inventory data with columns: Item Name, SKU, Quantity, Reorder Level, Unit Price, Supplier. Apply conditional formatting rules: (1) Highlight cells in Quantity column in RED when quantity is below reorder level (less than rule), (2) Highlight cells in Unit Price column in GREEN when price is above $100 (greater than rule), (3) Apply data bars to Quantity column for visual comparison, (4) Apply color scale to Unit Price column (green to red gradient). Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
